summary: Echoing March is a temporal war corridor where footsteps repeat across centuries. War-Shades march endlessly in fractured time, and Muramite commanders exploit the instability to drill their armies.
history: Temporal fractures formed when Discord energy collided with War-Shade corruption.
Footsteps of fallen warriors began repeating endlessly across the plains.
Muramite commanders used the region to test troops against temporal echoes.
The Echoing Marshal emerged as the master of time-loop warfare.
